hints.title: Level Traversal Order
hints.text: Group nodes by their depth from the root. Compute the arithmetic mean of all values observed at each tier.

hints.title: Tier Sizing
hints.text: At each depth, inspect the number of elements present, calculate their sum, and append children for the next depth.

hints.title: Breadth-First Accumulation
hints.text: Process level by level using an iterative approach. For each level, loop over the current count of nodes, accumulate the total sum as a float, divide by the count, and collect the child nodes for the next iteration.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in the tree
M: maximum width of the tree
complexity.notes: Level order traversal summing node values per tier.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Traversing without tier delineation requires tracking depths separately and sorting.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Processing each tier breadth-wise caps extra memory at the maximum level size.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use 64-bit floating point arithmetic to prevent overflow when summing node values.
